newsitem.title: GERMANY: German DAX ends at record close, but off highs.
newsitem.headline: German DAX ends at record close, but off highs.

text.p: 1147 GMT - German DAX ends the bourse session at record closing level, catching up with late Wednesday afternoon gains in IBIS electronic session but off highs. Profit-taking has dragged on market but uptrend broadly viewed as intact, with market factors positive. Wall Street decline had little impact, Buba left rates unchanged as expected.
* September DTB DAX futures up 5.5 at 3,845.5.
* Daimler still higher on Cap Gemini sale.
* Bank shares, Siemems hurt by profit-taking.
* Telekom down, deal with Bonn fails to impress.
